intro.h2: Kitchens that still get compliments years later
paragraphs: Above & Beyond Construction and Renovations LLC handles kitchen remodeling Kernersville homeowners keep talking about. One reviewer wrote that they have had many compliments on their new kitchen. Another said a wall came down, the room opened up, and the compliments were still coming a year later.

What sets the team apart is how far a job can go. Nathan does not stop at cabinets. One client describes him bringing ideas for the new kitchen layout, then carrying the work through the dining room, living room, hallway and guest bedroom in one project. Reviewers also mention fair pricing, fast and efficient workers, and a crew they would call again.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Kernersville, and more

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Full kitchen rebuilds with new cabinets, counters, backsplash, lighting and flooring. Nathan helps work out the layout before anything is torn out, so the finished room fits how your family cooks and gathers. Kitchen work is what reviewers mention most.

image.alt: Gray shaker kitchen with stainless range hood, three pendant lights and a white peninsula countertop

items.name: Opening up walls and layouts
items.blurb: Want the kitchen to flow into the dining or living room? The team removes walls and rebuilds the space around a new layout. A Google reviewer said the open plan they got was still drawing compliments a full year after the job finished.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with gray cabinets and wood-look plank flooring running through to glass patio doors

items.name: Countertops and flooring
items.blurb: New countertops and new floors are part of most of their kitchens, from marble-look island tops to wood-look plank flooring laid through the whole room. Their Facebook page lists countertops and flooring among the services they offer in Kernersville.

image.alt: Galley side of a kitchen with gray cabinets, white countertops, stainless appliances and gray plank flooring

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Bathroom remodeling is listed among their services on Facebook. Call to talk through what you have in mind for your bathroom, from a simple refresh to a full rebuild, and Nathan can tell you how his team would approach the job.

items.name: Whole-home and sunroom projects
items.blurb: Bigger jobs are welcome. One client had the kitchen, dining room, guest bedroom, living room and hallway remodeled together. Another had an outside sunroom enclosed and turned into an inside room, with siding, drywall, paint, doors, windows and lighting.

image.alt: Built-in coffee station with gray lower cabinets and glass-front upper cabinets beside a living area

why_choose_us.h2: Why Kernersville homeowners hire Above & Beyond

items.title: Every Google review is five stars
items.text: All 9 people who reviewed the business on Google gave 5 stars. Quality of work and the new kitchen are the topics reviewers bring up most often.

items.title: Layout ideas from Nathan
items.text: A client who had five rooms remodeled said Nathan has great ideas on the layout of the new kitchen. You get a second set of eyes on how the space could work.

items.title: Pricing reviewers called fair
items.text: Two reviewers described the cost as reasonable or fair, including one whose project covered five rooms. Ask for a quote and compare it for yourself.

items.title: A crew clients hire again
items.text: Reviewers call the team efficient, pleasant, hardworking and prompt. One family says Nathan's team has always done excellent work for them across several different jobs.

about.h2: Meet Nathan and the Above & Beyond team
about.text: Above & Beyond Construction and Renovations LLC is a remodeling company based on Birch Hill Drive in Kernersville, North Carolina. Customers know it through Nathan, who meets with homeowners, talks through the layout and runs the work with his team. Their jobs range from single kitchens to whole-floor remodels and a sunroom turned into a year-round room. The common thread in their reviews is simple: the work looks great, the crew shows up and works hard, and people say they will call them again for the next project.
about.owner_role: Leads the team (named in Google reviews); last name not published

process.h2: How a remodel with Above & Beyond works

steps.title: Call or email
steps.text: Reach Nathan at (336) 505-1120 or by email, Monday to Friday 8 AM to 7 PM or Saturday morning, and describe the rooms you want changed.

steps.title: Walk through the layout
steps.text: Nathan looks at the space with you and shares ideas on the layout, such as removing a wall or moving the kitchen workspace.

steps.title: Agree on the plan and price
steps.text: You get a price for the work you choose. Reviewers have described the pricing on their projects as fair and reasonable.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The team handles the work, from walls and drywall to cabinets, counters, floors, paint and lighting, and reviewers note how fast they work.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: Walk the finished rooms with Nathan and point out anything you want adjusted before the job is closed out.

faq.h2: Questions about remodeling with Above & Beyond

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: Kitchen remodels are the most common job in their reviews. They also list bathroom remodeling, countertops and flooring on Facebook, and reviewers describe a five-room remodel covering the kitchen, dining room, guest bedroom, living room and hallway, plus a sunroom enclosed and converted into an inside room.

items.q: Can you take out a wall to open up my kitchen?
items.a: Yes, that is work they have done. A Google reviewer wrote that the team removed a wall and opened the space up beautifully, and that they were still getting compliments a year later. Call Nathan to talk through the wall you have in mind and your layout.

The Google profile lists Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 7 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to 1 PM. They are closed on Sunday. You can call (336) 505-1120 during those hours or send an email any time to nathanabovebeyondc@gmail.com.

items.q: How do I find out what my remodel will cost?
items.a: Call or email Nathan with a description of the rooms and what you want changed, and he can arrange to see the space and give you a price. Past clients have described the cost of their projects as reasonable and the pricing as fair.

The business is at 1215 Birch Hill Dr, Kernersville, NC 27284, and Kernersville is the town named on their Google and Facebook pages. If you live nearby and are not sure whether your home is in range, a quick phone call to (336) 505-1120 will answer it.

final_cta.text: Call Nathan and tell him about the room you want to change.
